bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches are allowed and searched. Nonclear bags undergo additional inspection; larger bags are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The venue recommends reserving nearby parking in advance through the parking service linked from its FAQ; it does not list an on-site lot or a fixed price.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The official Boston venue FAQ provides the 15 Lansdowne Street address but does not identify a rideshare loading area.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and beverages are sold inside and at the House of Blues restaurant and bar. Outside food and beverages are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The venue is wheelchair accessible; guests needing accommodations are encouraged to arrive 30 minutes before doors. Contact the venue about accessible tickets and seating.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The venue strictly prohibits re-entry after a guest leaves during a concert.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will Call opens one hour before doors. Bring a valid photo ID and the physical credit card used for the purchase; their names must match.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The show-day box office opens one hour before doors. Security screens guests using a wand, metal detector or pat-down and searches bags; exact door time is event-specific.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
